name: White Edge Sedge
desc: White Edge Sedge (Carex debilis): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Carex debilis, also known as white-edge sedge, Rudge's white-edge sedge, and flexuous white-edge sedge, is a species of flowering plant in the sedge family, Cyperaceae.
